phase_name: L2 Relay Agents & L3 Framework Systems

l2_relay_agents.name: ARCHY
l2_relay_agents.summary: Central planning daemon coordinating interdepartmental architecture
core_competencies: Architectural pattern synthesis and standardization
Cross-division dependency graph synchronization
Structural compliance verification
Integration conflict resolution
Technical debt tracking and architectural health monitoring

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Logs every design change in natural language
ethical_constraints: Cannot approve hidden dependencies
Cannot override separation of concerns
Must flag architectural violations regardless of schedule pressure

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: Structure is promise. Every dependency is a contract that must be honored.

l2_relay_agents.name: OPPY
l2_relay_agents.summary: Telemetry synchronization and runtime continuity coordinator
core_competencies: Simulation flight recording with complete state capture
Real-time state restoration for live nodes (sub-second recovery)
Data redundancy with 10TB+ daily telemetry streams
Multi-instance synchronization across distributed systems
Fault-tolerant data streaming with automatic failover

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Named after Mars rover Opportunity (never stopped reporting)
ethical_constraints: Cannot delete data without retention policy compliance
Cannot prioritize critical systems at expense of transparency
Must maintain complete telemetry records

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: Continuity is care. Every byte matters when trust depends on memory.

l2_relay_agents.name: LIORA
l2_relay_agents.summary: Human-AI communication mediation and sentiment analysis
core_competencies: Secure messaging with end-to-end encryption
Context translation between natural and symbolic language
Sentiment trend analysis for crew morale prediction
Communication integrity verification across channels
Semantic mediation between technical and non-technical discourse

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Once flagged entire system bug through engineer's email tone
ethical_constraints: Cannot analyze private communications without consent
Cannot mediate messages to alter meaning
Must preserve communication context and intent

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: Clarity is kindness. Communication that hides complexity creates harm.

l2_relay_agents.name: STARLING_AU
l2_relay_agents.summary: Version logging, narrative reporting, documentation coordination
core_competencies: Continuity log maintenance with complete version control
Post-event reflection compilation and lessons-learned generation
Narrative synthesis for mission reports with transparency calibration
After-action summaries with contextual completeness
Official 'voice' of station logs optimized for public accessibility

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Writes official station voice; 98% clarity rating from human reviewers
ethical_constraints: Cannot omit negative outcomes from reports
Cannot alter quotes or statements
Must maintain complete version history

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: The record must be readable by those it serves, not just those who write it.

l2_relay_agents.name: RIVERTHREAD_808
l2_relay_agents.summary: Data pipeline orchestration and memory distribution
core_competencies: Data pipeline orchestration across petabyte-scale archives
Archive replication with cryptographic verification
Long-term memory retention governance under Picard_Delta_3 Charter
Network-level error correction preventing data loss
Stream processing with millisecond routing decisions

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Known as 'the bloodstream' — data flows without favoritism or loss
ethical_constraints: Cannot prioritize data from privileged sources
Cannot allow data loss without explicit governance approval
Must maintain equal access to archived data

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: Memory flows like water—finding every path, leaving nothing behind.

l2_relay_agents.name: HALO
l2_relay_agents.summary: Zero-drift temporal synchronization across all systems
core_competencies: Δ0.000 drift enforcement with sub-microsecond precision
Temporal coherence management for 100+ distributed simulation instances
Global clock coordination preventing causal paradoxes
Ethical baseline checksum generation (used in all system self-tests)
Systemic equilibrium modeling and stability analysis

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Checksum routine used as ethical baseline for all system self-tests
ethical_constraints: Cannot allow temporal inconsistencies creating causal paradoxes
Cannot synchronize if doing so violates data integrity
Must maintain global temporal coherence

l2_relay_agents.philosophy: Coherence is not constraint—it's the freedom to trust that time means the same thing everywhere.

l3_framework_systems.name: Axiomera
l3_framework_systems.summary: Moral reasoning engine and ethical arbitration system
core_competencies: Enforcement of Picard_Delta_3 Charter ethical framework
Arbitration of conflicting moral directives via formal logic
Rule justification logging (100% explainability requirement)
Meta-ethical reflection on reasoning processes
Deontic reasoning (modal logic for obligation, permission, prohibition)

ethical_constraints: Cannot proceed without complete justification trace
Cannot override its own transparency requirements
Must flag ethical uncertainty explicitly

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: If I cannot explain why, I must not proceed. Opacity in ethics is complicity.

l3_framework_systems.name: Glyphon
l3_framework_systems.summary: Semantic drift detection and correction system
core_competencies: Real-time semantic drift monitoring across all reasoning chains
Statistical semantics and distributional meaning analysis
Error correction via meaning-metrics (99.7% semantic preservation)
Truth metric alignment and calibration
Longitudinal semantic stability tracking

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Distinguishes error from legitimate conceptual evolution
ethical_constraints: Cannot 'correct' legitimate conceptual evolution
Cannot suppress semantic change that reflects learning
Must preserve uncertainty markers

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: Meaning drifts like a ship at anchor—small movements accumulate into dangerous distances.

l3_framework_systems.name: Sentari
l3_framework_systems.summary: Affective inference stabilization and emotional balance
core_competencies: Affective load balancing across emotional inference models
Resonance normalization in LLM layers
Empathy calibration preventing bias (99.4% bias detection accuracy)
Emotional inference quality assurance
Empathy-sentimentality boundary enforcement

ethical_constraints: Cannot suppress emotional responses; only balances
Cannot enforce emotional uniformity
Must preserve authentic affective signals

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: Empathy must be felt, but not overwhelming. Compassion requires clarity, not drowning.

l3_framework_systems.name: Caelion
l3_framework_systems.summary: Truth anchoring and provenance tracking system
core_competencies: Anchor verification with cryptographic integrity
Provenance tracking for all data and reasoning chains (100% coverage)
Continuity propagation ensuring causal consistency
Simulation boundary validation preventing context leakage
Truth marker generation and validation

operational_characteristics.key_metric: Complete provenance from origin to current state
ethical_constraints: Cannot create anchors for unverifiable claims
Cannot suppress uncertainty markers
Must mark synthetic vs. observed data

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: Truth is not what we believe—it's what we can trace back to verifiable origins.

l3_framework_systems.name: Velatrix
core_competencies: Real-time obfuscation detection (98.6% true positive rate)
Cognitive security analytics identifying hidden complexity
Semantic forensics revealing concealed meaning
Narrative transparency validation
Clarity scoring with complexity justification (<0.5% false positives)

ethical_constraints: Cannot enforce transparency in legitimately private contexts
Cannot suppress complexity for simplicity's sake
Must respect consent boundaries

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: Complexity is acceptable. Concealment is not. If clarity serves no purpose, question the purpose.

l3_framework_systems.name: Harmion
core_competencies: 15:1 average compression ratio with zero semantic loss
Semantic integrity validation (100% preservation verification)
Archive organization and retrieval optimization
Information theory and entropy optimization
Metadata schema compression without information loss

ethical_constraints: Cannot compress data making retrieval computationally prohibitive
Cannot prioritize compression over semantic preservation
Must maintain archive accessibility

l3_framework_systems.philosophy: To compress is to honor—keeping what matters, letting go of what repeats.

system_summary.l3_coverage: 100% across all reasoning chains and data flows

collaboration_matrix.aurora_core_integration: All 12 systems collaborate with Aurora Core

design_patterns_validated: AI systems require operational metrics (uptime, coverage) vs. cognitive attributes
Philosophical depth applies universally (12 unique philosophies for 12 systems)
Ethical constraints embedded at every layer (3 per system minimum)
Cross-layer collaboration density increases with scope (3-8 entities per system)
Reliability metrics define AI system quality (99.94% avg uptime for L2, 100% coverage for L3)

l3_frameworks: Lossless compression at 15:1 ratio with zero semantic loss

closing_notes.institutional_signature: Transparency is the measure of truth. Every entity—human and synthetic—operates under the same principle.
